Lalahen

Proverbs

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka baseen te me Lalahen, sabeka ne klasiyan te pegpanulu eyew ka keet-etawan te Manama due eg-ikulen ke egmenuwen te peg-ugpe ne matareng. Kasuluhan kayi, sika se pegpanulu meyitenged te peg-ugpe te etew. Ka sabeka ne mateles ne nasulat kayi ka: “Ka pegkaaldek ne Magbebaye iyan egpuunan te katagseb” (1:7; 9:10). Ka me Lalahen, impeg-iling ke nekey ka meupiya ne egkaangey ta ke iyan ta eg-ikulen ka katagseb wey kene ne sika se keungelan. Su ka dalan te me makasesale, marusilem pad du te delem (4:19), wey ka dalan te matareng, egpekeiling te sikan pad egkasi-si ne kaliwaswasan ne egkapahan-ganaran egmalayag taman te egsile en iya ka aldew (v18).

The reading_document of the Sayings, one kind of teaching so_that the people of God (MS Manama) have (something) to follow how they live in the right_way. Most of it, (are) the teaching about (daily) living of the people. One of the wonderful (thing) which written here is: “The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom” (1:7; 9: 10). Sayings, (are) being compared with what good we(incl) can_obtain if we(incl) follow wisdom and not with the foolishness. Because the road/path of the sinners, (is) darker than night (4:19), and road/path of righteous, (is) like dawn which slowly_to_shine until the sun is rise (v18).

Ka me Lalahen, immanlimud ne me meupiya ne me lalag ne egpakamatagseb te egbasa.

Sayings, (are) collected good words that give_wisdom to (those) who read.

Ka tuyu te me lalahen

The purpose of sayings

11 Ka me lalahen ni Sulumun, ne anak ni Dabid ne Hari te Israil.

11 The sayings of Sulumun, child of Dabid the king of Israil.

2 Ka tuyu te seini ne me lalahen, ka pegbehey te katagseb wey katuenan. Egpakabehey man-e seini te me katuenan te pegsabut te me panulu ne egpakabehey te katagseb. 3 Egpakapanulu seini te peg-ikul te me panulu, pegkamatareng, eleg ne peggukum, wey meupiya te duma. 4 Egpakabehey seini te katagseb te seeye se ware pad hanew, wey egpakabehey te me kabatbataan te katuenan te peg-alam. 5 Ka matagseb ne egpakarineg kayi, egkatimulan se katuenan wey seeye se duen e katuenan te pegnengneng, egkapanulu pad 6 eyew egkasabut dan ka igpasabut te me lalahen, me panunggilingan, wey ka egmaantukan te me matagseb.

2 The purpose of these sayings, (is) giving wisdom and knowledge. These can also give skills/knowledge to understand the teachings that can give wisdom. 3 These can_teach in following the teachings, righteousness, correct judging, and good to other. 4 These can_give wisdom to those without_ awareness _yet, and can_give knowledge to the youth (LIT young_ones) for choosing. 5 The wise (people) that hear this, (their) knowledge/skills will_be_increased and those who have knowledge/skills at knowing, will_be_taught more 6 so_that they can_understand what_is_meant by sayings, examples/parables, and the riddles of the wise(pl).

Ka me keupianan ne egpuun te katagseb

The benefits from wisdom

21 Anak, kene nu lingawi ka me lalag ku keykew wey tantanuri nu ka me suhu ku. 2 Pammineha nu ka pegpanulu ne egpakabehey te katagseb wey sumsumana nu ke nekey ka igpasabut kayi. 3 Pakannekal ka ne egpakaangken te katuenan te pegnengneng wey pegsabut. 4 Pamitawa nu seini iling te pegpamitew nu te seleppi wey ke me karatuan naa ne inggeles. 5 Ke eggimuwen nu seini, egkanengnengan nu ke nekey ka kaluwasan te pegkaaldek te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey egkasabut nu ka katuenan meyitenged kandin. 6 Ka Magbebaye ka migbehey te katagseb, wey diye te kandin egpuun ka katuenan te pegsabut. 7 Egbehayan din te katagseb seeye se me matareng wey egpangabangan din seeye se ware igkengarew-ey. 8 Egtamengan din ka egbayaan te seeye se me matareng wey te seeye se me matinumanen kandin.

21 Child, don't forget(sg) my words to you(sg) and remember my commands. 2 Listen(sg) to the teaching which gives wisdom and think what it means. 3 Strive(sg) to obtain knowledge and understanding. 4 Search(sg) for it like your(sg) searching of money and the hidden treasures. 5 If you(sg) do this, you(sg) will_know the meaning of fearing of the Lord God, and you(sg) will_understand the knowledge about him. 6 The Lord is (the one who) gives wisdom, and knowledge to understand is from him. 7 He will_give wisdom to those who (are) righteous and he will_help those who have_nothing to_be_scolded_for. 8 He will_watch the paths of those who have good_behavior and those who are good.

9 Emun ke egpammineg ka keddi, egkasabut nu ke nekey ka pegkamatareng, ka eleg ne peggukum, wey ka meupiya te duma. Egpakataha ka ke nekey ka eleg ne eggimuwen nu. 10 Egkeyimu ka ne matagseb wey egpakabehey keykew te kahale ka katuenan nu. 11 Egpakapangabang keykew ka katuenan nu te peg-alam wey egpakabulig keykew ka salabutan nu. 12 Ka katagseb ka egpakapaalihu keykew puun te seeye se maddeet se hinimuwan wey te seeye se maddeet ne egpanlelalag. 13 Migsuwey sikandan te maheteng ne peg-ugpe wey mig-ikul te eggimuwen te me etew ne diye te marusilem. 14 Egkengaaley sikandan ne eggimu te seyyup wey egkahale te maddeet ne hinimuwan dan, 15 mareet ka me batasan dan wey kene ne meupiya ka eggimuwen dan.

9 If you(sg) listen to me, you(sg) will_understand what (is) being_righteous, the correct judging, and good to other. You(sg) will_understand what (is) the correct thing_ for_you(sg) _to_do. 10 You(sg) will_become wise and your(sg) knowledge will_be_able_to_give you(sg) joy. 11 Your(sg) knowledge to choose will_be_able to protect you(sg) and your(sg) understanding will_be_able_to_help you(sg). 12 Wisdom will_be_able_to_deliver you(sg) from those (people) who do evil (things) and to those whose words are bad. 13 They deviated from the right (way) of living and followed (what) people in darkness have_done. 14 They are delighted/entertained in doing evil/mistakes and are_happy with the evil (things) they've done, 15 their attitude are bad and their deeds are not good.

16 Ka katagseb degma ka egpakapaalihu keykew puun te baliyuten ne malitan ne egginalig keykew te mateles ne me lalag din. 17 In-engkeran te sika ne malitan ka lukes ne migpangasawa kandin te bate-bate pad sikandin. Inlingawan din e ka saad din te Manama te peg-asawa rin. 18 Ka dalan peendiye te baley rin, migleus diye te kamatayen. Ke egbaye ka te dalan peendiye te baley rin, iling de te migpeendiye ka te inged te me minatey. 19 Ware minsan hentew ne egbaye kandin ne egpakalibed pad, wey ke egpakatulitu naan pad te dalan peendiye te inged te me mallenggew. 20 Purisu ilingi nu ka peg-ugpe te me matareng wey ikula nu ka dalan te meupiya ne me etew. 21 Su ka me meupiya se pegbebatasan wey ware igkarew-ey, egpabulus ne eg-ugpe te seini ne inged. 22 Piru ka maddeet ne etew wey me limbungen, egkaawe te inged; egpamaruten sikandan iling te me hilamunen.

16 Wisdom also will_be_able_to_deliver you(sg) from the lustful/immoral who will_tempt you(sg) by her wonderful/flattery words. 17 That woman left the man who married her when she was young. She forgot her vows to God when she got_married. 18 The road to her house, leads_down to death. If you(sg) walk the road going_to her house, it's just like you(sg) go to the place of the dead. 19 No who ever that goes_to her will_be_able_to_come_back, or will_be_able_to_find the path going to the place of the alive (people). 20 Therefore imitate(sg) the living of the righteous (people) and follow the path of the good people. 21 Because those(pl) who have good conduct/behavior and (those) who have_nothing_to_scold, will_continue to leave in this place. 22 But the wicked people and deceivers, will_be_disappear from the place; they will_be_pulled_out like grasses.

Ka panulu te me anak

The teaching of/for children

41 Me anak, pammineha niyu ka pegpanulu te amey niyu wey linglingaa niyu sika ne egpakaangken kew te katuenan. 2 Me meupiya ka impanulu ku kaniyu purisu kene niyu seini balahara. 3 Te bate e pad, inggeyinawaan a te iney ku su sabsabeka ku man de te anak din. 4 Impanulu a te amey ku te miggenendue, “Itines nu te pusung nu ka impanulu ku keykew, wey tumana nu ka me suhu ku eyew egmalayat ka umul nu. 5 Pakannekal ka ne egpakaangken te katagseb wey pegsabut. Tantanuri nu wey ikula nu ka impanulu ku keykew. 6 Dakeli nu te geyinawa ka katagseb wey kene nu engkeri wey egtantanuran ka nikandin, wey egpangabangan. 7 Seini ka puunan te katabseb: pakannekal ka ne egmatagseb ka. Ne minsan nekey ka eggimuwen nu, pakannekal ka ne egkatimulan ka katagseb nu. 8 Geyinawei nu ka katagseb wey kene nu seini lekei, wey igpabantug ka nikandin. 9 Egpekeiling ka katagseb te tetelesi ne bulak ne insaluub te ulu ne egpakabehey keykew te kabantug.”

Ka pegpaney-paney meyitenged te pegpanlibug

The warning about adultery

51 Anak, pammineg ka ayad-ayad te katagseb wey katuenan ne igpanulu ku keykew 2 eyew egkateu ka ne eg-alam, wey ke egmenuwen te eglalag-lalag ne egkeilaan ne matagseb ka. 3 Su ka peglalag-lalag te baliyuten ne malitan, egpekeiling keemis te teneb wey egpekeiling kalanang te lana te ulibu. 4 Piru te katammanan, ware lein ne iggaat din keykew, ke kene, iyan de ka pepeiti iling te aperu, wey sesakiti iling te pali. 5 Emun ke eg-ikul ka kandin, egpakaruma ka kandin diye te inged te me minatey. 6 Kene sikandin eglinga-linga te dalan ne egpeendiye te umul. Ware kalintahaan din ne nalaag-laag bes sikandin.

51 Child, listen carefully to wisdom and knowledge that I'm going to teach you(sg) 2 so_that you(sg) will_know how to choose, and how to speak that you(sg) will_be_known that you(sg) (are) wise. 3 Because the (way) the lustful/immoral woman speaks, the sweetness is like honey and (its) shiny/greasy is like olive oil. 4 But in the end, no other (things) she will_left with you(sg), but_rather, it's just bitter like bile, and very_painful like a wound. 5 If you(sg) follow her, you(sg) can go with her to the place of the dead. 6 She will_ not _pay_attention to the way/path going to life. 7 Therefore listen to me children, and never forget what_ I _said to you(sg). 8 Keep_far(pl) from the woman like her, don't(pl) ever going closer to the door of her house. 9 If not, other people will_be (the one) receiving your(pl) honor, and you(pl) will_die in the hands of the people who don't have mercy. 10 Then the foreigners will_take_away your(pl) wealth which you(pl) have_been worked very_hard. 11 And if you(pl) get_older, you(pl) will_mourn due to sickness which gnaw your(pl) flesh. 12 Then you(pl) can only say, “Why we(incl) didn't cause_to_be_discipline and we(incl) didn't remember the scolding to us(incl)! 13 We(incl) didn't listen and pay_attention to our(incl) teachers warnings. 14 Therefore we(incl) were ashamed there in the assembly of the people.”

15 Kene nu limbungi ka asawa nu wey sikandin de geyinawei nu. 16 Kene ne meupiya ne egkatalagtag ka beuhan ne eg-inuman nu diye te maddiyu; kene ne meupiya ne ka sebseb nu egpakales-ag diye te me deralanen. 17 Iyan nu re huliri ka asawa nu, wey kene ka te lein ne malitan. 18 Purisu, gale-gale kew te asawa nu, wey egpanalanginan kew perem te Magbebaye ne Manama. 19 Mateles sikandin wey mekein-inniyat iling te usa. Purisu egkeeyaman ka perem te kumeng din, wey layun ka perem egkabukusi te geyinawa rin. 20 Anak, kene ka peinniyat te baliyuten ne malitan. Kene ne meupiya ne eglunggun ka te asawa te duma. 21 Nakakita ka Magbebaye te langun ne eggimuwen nu, wey egtengteng sikandin minsan hendei ka egpabaye. 22 Ka hinimuwan te maddeet ne etew, egpekeiling te baled. Egkeuney sikandan egsahad te kandan mismu ne sale. 23 Ne egpatey sikandan tenged su imbalahad dan ma ka pegdisiplina kandan, wey egkengallaag-laag sikandan tenged te egkasublaan ne keungelan dan.

the ways which is not good, and bad words.

honor, well_being and abundant (life)/prosperity.

before he made the world.

Ka katagseb wey ka keungelan

Wisdom and foolishness

91 Ka katagseb, egpekeiling te etew ne migbebaley wey insungkalehan din te pitu. 2 Miglape sikandin te me ayam din eyew egsahakeen. Ne in-andam din ka me pegkeen wey me inumen. 3 Insuhu din ka me suluhuanen din ne me malitan eyew te pegginggat te me etew diye te bariyu te migkahi, 4 “Tambung kew te sahakeen, me etew ne ware aperu!” Ne egkahi sikandin diye te me umbeg, 5 “Hendini kew, keen kew te egkakeen wey te inumen ne in-andam ku para kaniyu. 6 Engkeri niyud e ka keungelan niyu wey ugpe kew ne iling te matagseb ne me etew eyew egmalayat ka umul niyu.”

91 Wisdom, is like a person who build_a_house and put_ seven _pillars. 2 He slaughtered animals for a feast. And he prepared food and drink/wine. 3 Then he sent his women servants to invite people in the village saying, 4 “Join(pl) the feast, people without awareness!” And he said to the foolish (people), 5 “Come(pl), eat the food and drink_the_wine I have prepared for you(pl). 6 Leave_behind your(pl) foolishness and live(pl) like wise people so_that your(pl) life will_be_prolonged.”

7 Ke egsaparan nu ka hambuhen ne etew, egkapeyilawan ke re iya; ke egsaparan nu ka mareet ne etew, egdereetan ke re iya nikandin. 8 Kene nu sapari ka etew ne hambuhen su egdumutan ke re nikandin. Piru ke egsaparan nu ka etew ne matagseb, egtahuren ka nikandin. 9 Ke egpanuluen nu ka etew ne matagseb, egkatimulan ka katagseb din; ke egpanuluen nu ka etew ne matareng, egkatimulan ka katuenan din.

7 When you(sg) scold the arrogant person, he will_cause_ you(sg) _to_be_ashamed(sg); when you(sg) scold the evil person, he will_ only _destroy you(sg). 8 Don't(sg) scold the arrogant person because he will_ just _hate you(sg). But if you(sg) scold the wise person, you(sg) will_be honored by_him/her. 9 When you(sg) teach the wise person, then his wisdom will_increase; when you(sg) teach the righteous person, then his knowledge will_increase.

10 Ka pegkaaldek te Magbebaye ne Manama ka bunsuranan te katagseb, wey ka peg-ila te Matulus ne Manama ka egpuunan te salabutan. 11 Egpakamalayat te umul nu ka katagseb. 12 Egpakameupiya keykew ka katagseb, piru ke lalung ka, sikeykew re iya ka egkabaybayaran.

10 The fear of the Lord God is the beginning of wisdom, and knowing the Holy God is the source of understanding. 11 Wisdom can prolong you(sg) life. 12 Wisdom can give_ you(sg) _goodness, but if you(sg) are worthless (LIT fool), you(sg) indeed will_be_the_one to suffer.

13 Ka keungelan, egpekeiling te malitan ne be-baan, ware katuenan, wey ware hilew. 14 Diye sikandin migpinpinnuu te gumawan te baley rin wey ke diye naa te pinnuuwan ne diye te bariyu 15 wey egpangumew te me etew ne egmanlihad ne kene mule egpangilabet te eggimuwen te duma. 16 Migkahi sikandin, “Tambung kew te sahakeen, me etew ne ware aperu!” Ne migkahi man-e sikandin diye te me umbeg, 17 “Meemis ka weyig ne tinakew, wey mananam ka paan ne eggelhelesan de te egkeen.” 18 Ne ware nakataha ka me etew ne ka eggendiye te baley rin, egkapatey bes, wey ka seeye se nakaseled e, diyad e te inged te me minatey.

13 The foolishness, is like a talkative woman, without knowledge, and no shame. 14 She is sitting at the door of her house or there in the sitting_place in the village 15 and calling_out (those) who are passing_by that don't mind what other doing. 16 She said, “Join(pl) the feast, people has_no good understanding (LIT no gall_bladder)!” And she said to the foolish, 17 “The stolen water is sweet, and the bread eaten in secret is delicious.” 18 People don't know that when (they) go to her house, will_die [surprise], and those who already entered, are already in the place of the dead.

Ka me lalahen ni Sulumun

The sayings of/by Sulumun

101 Seini ka me lalahen ni Sulumun:

101 These (are) the sayings by Sulumun:

Ka anak ne matagseb, egpakapahale te amey wey iney rin,

The child that's wise, will_give_joy to his/her father and mother,

piru ka anak ne kene egtulik, egpakapalaggew kandan.

but the child that doesn't obey, will_give_sorrow to_them.

2 Kene egpakameupiya keykew

2 Won't do_good to_you(sg)

ka karatuan ne egkaangken nu pinaahi te limbung,

the wealth that you(sg) possess by_means of cheating,

piru egpakaluwas mule keykew ka pegkamatareng.

but on_the_contrary righteousness will_save you(sg).

3 Kene egtuhutan te Magbebaye ne Manama ne eggutasan ka me matareng,

3 The Lord God won't permit that the righteous (ones) go_hungry,

piru egbalabahan din ka igkeupii te maddeet ne etew.

but he blocks the desire(s) of evil(pl) people.

4 Egpakaayu-ayu ka pegpapepehul,

4 Being_lazy causes_poverty,

piru egpakaratu ka pegkamabasuk.

but working_hard causes_wealthiness.

5 Ka kanakan ne eglilimud te egkakeen te tinggaani, matagseb,

5 The young_man (LIT unmarried_man) that stores food in the harvest time, (is) wise,

piru ka kanakan ne egliplipereng de, egpakapeyilew.

but the young_man (LIT unmarried_man) that just naps, will_bring_shame.

6 Egpanalanginan te Magbebaye ka matareng ne etew,[fn]

6 The righteous person will_be_blessed by the Lord,[fn]

piru ka me lalag ne impanlalag te maddeet ne etew, iyan de egdereet kandan.

but the words spoken(pl) by evil(pl) people, indeed just destroy them.

7 Ke egpatey ka matareng ne etew, egkeyimu sikandin ne panalangin te duma, wey layun egkatanuri,

7 If the righteous person dies, he/she will_become a blessing to other(s), and always remembered,

piru mahaan de egkalingawi ka mareet ne etew.

but the bad/evil person will_be_forgotten quickly.

8 Ka matagseb ne etew, egdawat te me meupiya ne tambag.

8 The wise person, accepts to good advice(pl).

Piru egkahunaan ka egpangasak de due te ware karuan.

But the person that speaks/discuss nonsense will_be destroyed.

9 Ka matareng ne etew, mariyu te karereetan,

9 The righteous person, (is) far from destruction,

piru ka etew ne egpekeyimu te mareet, egkasapenan.

but the person who does bad/evil, will_be_caught_at_it.

10 Ka etew ne egpanungkilat ne mareet se tuyu, egpakabehey te kalaggew.

10 The person that winks for bad/evil purpose, causes sorrow.

Ne ka etew ne egpangasak de due te ware karuan egkahunaan.

And the person that speaks/discuss nonsense will_be destroyed.

11 Ka lalag te matareng ne etew, egpekeiling te sebseb ne egpakabehey te umul,

11 The word(s) of a righteous person, are_like a spring that gives life,

piru egpakarereet ka lalag te mareet ne etew.

but the word(s) of a bad/evil person destroy.

12 [xr]Egpekeyimu re te samuk ka pegkasundug,

12 [xr]Sulking just makes a disturbance,

piru ka geyinawa, egpakapasaylu te langun ne seyyup.

but love, can_forgive all mistakes.

13 Ka etew ne due salabutan, eglalag-lalag ne due katagseb.

13 The person who has understanding, speak with knowledge.

Piru ke etew ne kene egtulik, eleg ne egdisiplineen wey egparusaan.

But the (one who) is not follow_instruction, worthy to_be_disciplined and to_be_punished.

14 Ka matagseb ne etew, egpakannekal ne egtimul te katagseb din,

14 The wise person, striving to add his wisdom,

piru ka eglalahen te etew ne ungel, egpakarereet de.

but what a fool says, can only destroy.

15 Egpakabulig te meyaman ka karatuan din,

15 The wealth of the rich can_help,

piru ka keyirapan te egkaayu-ayu iyan egpakarereet kandin.

but the difficulties of the poor will destroy him/her.

16 Ka bayad te matareng ne etew, iyan sika se malayat ne umul

16 The wage of the righteous person, that is (a) long life

piru eglegparan ka mareet ne etew.

but the evil person will_be_punishment.

17 Ka etew ne egpalintutuu ke egsaparan,

17 The person who obey/listens when scolded,

egmalayat se umul,

(her/his) life will_be_prolonged,

piru ka etew ne kene eg-angken te seyyup din, egkatarin-tarin iya.

but the person who doesn't accept her/his fault/mistake, will_be_lost indeed.

18 Ubaten ka etew ne eggeeles te langet,

18 The person who hides (her/his) anger is (a) liar,

wey egkeungel ka etew ne egsesalupet.

and the person who gossip is (a) fool.

19 Ke egpanaweles ka eglalag,

19 If you(sg) talk nonsense,

egkaseyyup ka iya,

you(sg) will_ indeed _made_mistakes,

piru ke matagseb ka,

but if you(sg) (are) wise,

peeneng-eneng ke re.

just keep_quiet.

20 Ka me lalag te matareng ne etew, egpekeiling te seleppi ne neelin ne pelata,

20 The words of a wise person, is like money which is pure silver,

piru ware karuan te suman-suman te maddeet ne etew.

but the thinking of the evil people is worthless.

21 Ka me lalag te matareng ne etew, egpakabehey te keupianan te masulug ne etew.

21 The words of the righteous person, can give_goodness to many people.

Piru egpatey ka egkengeungel su ware ma me salabutan dan.

But the fools will_die because they don't have knowledge.

22 Egkaratu ka etew pinaahi re te panalangin te Magbebaye,

22 The person will_become_rich only by the blessings of the Lord,

wey kene ne pinaahi te peglasey-lasey te himu.

and not by means of working_hard.

23 Ka ungel ne etew, egkahale ne eggimu te mareet,

23 The fool person, is enjoying doing wrong,

piru ka etew ne meupiya se salabutan, iyan mule igkahale ka katagseb.

but the person that has good sense/knowledge, enjoy wisdom on_the_contrary.

24 Ke nekey ka igkaaldek te mareet ne etew, nasi egkeyitabu kandin,

24 Whatever bad people afraid_of, will_ indeed _happens to him,

piru egkaangken mule te matareng ne etew ka igkeupii rin.

but the righteous person will_obtain what he wants.

25 Ke egginguma ka keyirapan ne iling te bagyu, egkeuyan ka mareet ne etew,

25 When hardship comes like (a) storm/typhoon, evil person will_be_carried_away,

piru kene mule egkamenu ka matareng ne etew.

but the righteous on_the_other_hand will_ not _be_hurt.

26 Iling te suka ne egpakapangingilu te ngipen

26 Just as vinegar that give_sensitive_to_ the _teeth

wey ke ebel naa ne egpakapaluwe te mata, ka pehulen egpakabelu degma te seeye se egsuhu kandin.

or a smoke that causes_ the eyes _to_tear, the lazy can anger to the (one who) commands him.

27 Ka etew ne due pegkaaldek te Magbebaye, egmalayat se umul.

27 The person who has fear of the Lord, (his/her) life will_be_prolonged.

Piru mahaan de mule egpatey ka maddeet ne etew.

But on_the_contrary bad people will_die easily.

28 Ka pegpallateng te me matareng ne etew, egpakabehey kandan te kahale,

28 The hopes of the righteous people, can give them happiness,

piru kene mule egginguma ka in-iman-iman te maddeet ne etew.

but on_the_contrary what bad people hoped_for will_ not _come.

29 Egpangabangan te Magbebaye ka ware sale,

29 The Lord helps/defends the (one) without sin,

piru egdereetan din mule ka maddeet se hinimuwan.

but he will_destroy the (one who) does evil.

30 Ka matareng ne etew, kene egkaweil,

30 The righteous person, can't be_moved,

piru ka mareet ne etew, kene egkaluhey kayi te tane.

but evil person, will_ not _last_long here on earth.

31 Ka me matareng ne etew, matagseb ne eglalag,

31 The righteous person, talks wisely,

piru egpakarereet mule ka eglalahen te mareet ne etew.

but on_the_contrary the talks of an evil person can destroy.

32 Ka matareng ne etew, nakanengneng ke nekey ka eleg ne iglalag,

32 The righteous person, know what is fitting to say,

piru ka mareet ne etew, iyan de nanengnengan ka maddeet ne me lalag.

but evil person, only know bad words.

111 Igkeepes te Magbebaye ne Manama

111 The Lord God get_anger

te me etew ne eggamit te kene ne eleg ne timbangan,

the people who will_use not correct scales,

piru egkahale sikandin te eleg ne pegtimbang.

but he's happy with correct scaling.

2 Egkeyilawan ka etew ne hambuhen,

2 The proud will_be_shamed,

piru egkeyimu ne matagseb ka mapariralemen.

but the humble will_become wise.

3 Ka keupiya te matareng ne etew, egpakapanulu kandin te eleg ne eggimuwen din.

3 The goodness of a righteous/sensible person, can_teach him/her the correct things_ for him/her _to_do.

Piru ka pegpapitew-pitew re te etew ne kene egkasalihan, egpakarereet kandin.

But the show-off person that can't be_trusted, (it) will_destroy him/her.

4 Kene egpakaluwas ka karatuan te etew

4 The wealth of a person can't_save

ke igpeyingume e te Manama ka kamatayen,

if the God sends death,

piru egpakaluwas puun te kamatayen ka pegkamatareng.

but righteousness can_save from death.

5 Egpakameupiya te peg-ugpe ka pegkamatareng,

5 Being_righteous can_do_good to living,

piru egpakarereet te etew ka mareet ne hinimuwan din.

but person's evil actions can_destroy him/her.

6 Egpakaluwas te etew ne matareng ka pegkamatareng,

6 Righteousness can_save righteous person,

piru egpakarereet kandin ka eyam din.

but his/her appetite can_destroy him/her.

7 Ke egpatey e ka etew ne mareet,

7 If an evil person dies,

egkaawe e degma ka pegpallateng din,

his/her hope is also lost,

wey warad karuan te langun ne in-iman-iman din ne karatuan.

and there's_no purpose/value of all that he/she desires wealth.

8 Egluwasen te Manama ka etew ne matareng,

8 The person who is righteous/sensible will_be_saved by the Lord God,

piru egpakasalerep mule te kasamuk ka etew ne mareet.

but evil people on_the_contrary will_be_overtaken_by_disaster of disorder.

9 Egpakarereet te duma ka me lalag te me etew ne ware mig-ila te Manama,

9 The words of people who don't acknowledge/recognize the Lord God can_destroy other(s),

piru ka katagseb te matareng ne etew, egpakaluwas kandin.

but the wisdom of a righteous/sensible person, can_save him/her.

10 Egkengahale ka me mahinged te sabeka ne siyudad

10 The residence of one city will_be_glad

ke egmeupiya ka peg-ugpe te me matareng ne etew,

wey egkengahale degma sikandan ke egpatey ka maddeet ne etew.

and they will_be_glad also if the bad people will_die.

11 Egmatubung ka siyudad pinaahi te me panalangin te Manama te me matareng ne etew,

11 The city will_prosper by means of the blessings of God to the righteous people,

piru egkareetan seini tenged te me lalag te maddeet ne me etew.

but it will_be_destroyed because of the words of evil(pl) people.

12 Egpanampele te duma ka ware salabutan,

12 The (person) without sense insults other(s),

piru egpeeneng-eneng de ka matagseb.

but the wise (person) just keeps_quiet.

13 Ka be-baan, egpangguhud te iggeles de perem,

13 The gossiper (LIT mouthy), tells_stories that should just be_hidden,

piru ka matareng ne etew kene egpangawang egpangguhud.

but (on_the_contrary) the righteous/sensible person does not talk_nonsense.

14 Egkahuhus ka sabeka ne nasud ke ware matagseb ne egpangulu,

14 A (LIT One) nation with no wise leader will_be_demolished,

piru egmalig-en seini ke masulug ka me talagtambag.

but it becomes_strong if there are many advisors.

15 Egpekegsendit ka ke egsaad ka ne egbulig te sabeka ne lapu;

15 You(sg) can_regret if you(sg) promise to_help a (LIT one) foreigner;

meupiya pad mule ke kene nu sika eggimuwen.

it is better if you(sg) don't do that.

16 Egtahuren ka meupiya ne malitan,

16 The good woman is respected,

piru karatuan de ka egkaangey te maddeet ne me etew.

but evil persons just gets wealthy.

17 Ke meupiya ka te duma,

17 If you(sg) are_kind to other(s),

ingkeyid-u nu degma ka pegkeetew nu,

you(sg) pitied your(sg) self also,

piru ke mabulut ka,

but if you(sg) are fierce,

indereetan nu re ka pegkeetew nu.

you(pl) only destroy your(sg) self.

18 Ka malehet, ware iya egkahaani te etew ne mareet,

18 The truth is, there's indeed no harvest of an evil person,

piru ka matareng, duen iya dasag ne egkarawat din.

but the righteous/sensible, there_will_ indeed _be a gift that_ he/she(sg) _will_receive.

19 Egkeuyag ka etew ne mapahetpet ne eggimu te matareng,

19 The person who is keen to do (what is) righteous/sensible will_live,

piru egpatey ka eggimu te mareet.

but the (one who) will_do bad will_die.

20 Egkeepes ka Magbebaye te seeye se iyan de egsumsumanen se mareet

20 The Lord God hates/feels_dirty those who just think_about evil

piru egkahale mule sikandin te seeye se eggimu te matareng.

but on_the_contrary he will_be_glad to those who will_do righteous (things).

21 Klaru iya ne eglegparan ka maddeet ne me etew,

21 (It is) clear indeed that bad people will_be_punished,

piru egluwasen mule ka me matareng.

but on_the_contrary the righteous will_be_saved.

22 Ka mateles ne malitan ne ware katuenan te peg-alam,

22 The beautiful woman without knowledge of choosing,

egpekeiling de te bulawan ne sising ne intangen diye te irung te babuy.

just like gold ring that put_in on the nose of (a) pig.

23 Meupiya se egpangkusan te igkeupii te matareng ne etew,

23 The out_come to the desire of a righteous person is good,

piru karereetan ka egpangkusan te egpallatengen te maddeet ne me etew.

but the out_come to what bad people are hoping is destruction.

24 Due me etew ne matumpis

24 There are people who (are) generous

piru egkanasnasian de iya egmeyaman,

but getting_more rich,

due degma me leheren

there (are) also greedy

piru nasi de iya egkaayut-ut.

but getting_poorer instead.

25 Egmatubung ka etew ne matumpis,

25 The person who (is) generous will_be_prosperous,

Ka tatelu ne pulu ne me lalahen

The thirty words

17 Pammineg ka te me lalag te matagseb ne me etew wey tantanuri nu seini. 18 Egkahale ka iya ke egtantanuran nu seini wey egkalalag nu. 19 Egkeupian a ne egsalig ka te Magbebaye, sikan naa ka inlalag ku seini keykew. 20 Migsusulat a te tatelu ne pulu (30) ne me panulu para kaniyu. Dakel ka egkaangey niyu ne katuenan wey me meupiya ne me tambag. 21 Ne pinaahi kayi egkanengnengan nu ka kamalehetan, wey egpakatabak ka te malehet te seeye se eg-inse keykew.

17 Listen to the words of the wise people and you(sg) remember it. 18 You(sg) will_be_happy if you(sg) pay_attention to it and you(sg) be_able_to_say (it). 19 I want you(sg) to trust the Lord, that's why I said this to you(sg). 20 I write thirty (30) teachings for you(pl). You(pl) can get great knowledge and good advice(s). 21 And through this you(sg) will_know the truth, and you(sg) can answer the truth to those who ask you(sg).

Ka duma pad ne me lalahen

Other sayings

23 Seini pad iya man-e ka me lalag te matagseb ne etew:

23 These (are) still the words of the wise person:

Kene ne meupiya te sabeka ne talaggukum ne due eglapihan din.24 Ke igpeila rin ne ware sale te nakasale, egdilusen sikandin, wey egdumutan te langun. 25 Piru ka talaggukum ne egparusa te nakasale, egpanalanginan iya wey egdeyrayen te langun.

It's not good for one judge to have (someone) to favor_with.24 If he shows that the sinner has no sin, he will_be_cursed, and hated by everyone. 25 But the judge who punishes the (one who) has sin, will_be_blesses and be_praised by everyone.

26 Ka malehet ne me tabak egpekeiling keupiya te harek te malehet ne alukuy.

26 The true answers is like a kiss of a true friend.

27 Impusi nu pa ka trabahu nu wey andama nu pa ka kamet nu, ne human ka pes-ek te baley nu.

27 Finish your(sg) work and prepare your(sg) field, before build your(sg) house.

28 Kene ka bayung te duma nu wey ke egpanlalag naa te ubat meyitenged kandin, ke ware eleg ne katarengan nu. 29 Kene ka kahi, “Eggimuwen ku kandin ka inggimu rin keddi, eyew egpakasuli a kandin.”

28 Don't accuse your(sg) companion or tell lies about him, if you(sg) have no enough reason(s). 29 Don't say, “I will_do to him what he did to me, so_that I can avenge (him).”

30 Miglihad a te kamet wey parasan te etew ne pehulen wey umbeg; 31 impanubuan e seini te me duhi wey ingkampetan e te hilamunen, wey nagguhus e ka me batu ne inlingut ialad dutu. 32 Ne duen ad e se migpalemlem te nakita ku. Ne seini ka naangey ku ne katuenan meyitenged dutu: 33 emun ke egliplipereng ke re, ke egpatutuyung ke re, wey egpangpangayepkep eyew eggimeley, 34 sahuhune ne eggingumaan ka te keyirapan iling te takawen ne tigkew eglepew.

30 I passed_by the field and a vineyard of a lazy person and foolish; 31 it is covered with thorns and weeds, and the stones which walled around it was destroyed. 32 And I meditate what_ I _have seen. And this is what_ I _have learned about it: 33 if you(sg) will_ just _sleep, you(sg) just dozing, and put_ your(sg) _hands_on_ (your) _shoulder and resting, 34 suddenly the difficulties will_come to you(sg) like a thief.

Ka duma pad ne me lalag ni Sulumun

The other words by Sulumun

251 Seini pad man-e ka duma ne me lalahen ni Sulumun ne in-ilingan te me etew ni Isikiyas ne Hari te Huda. 2 Egbantuhen ka Manama tenged te minsan nekey ne ware din ipahawa-hawa, piru egbantuhen ka Hari tenged te minsan nekey ne igpakapapitew rin.

251 These are some of the words of Sulumun whom the people of Isikiyas the king of Huda copied. 2 God will_be_honored due to everything which he didn't show_openly, but the king will_be_honored due to everything which he had shown.

3 Iling te langit ne kene egkeumaan, wey te dahat ne kene egkatirew tenged te karalem, kene degma egkanengnengan ka suman-suman te me Hari.

3 Like heaven that can't be_reached, and the sea that can't be_measured, the kings' thinking also can't be_known.

4 Awaa nu ka taang ne nakasewug te pelata, eyew egpakasayab te me tahuanan ka mannayab. 5 Te iling due ne paahi, ke egpandelrelen nu ka maddeet ne talagtambag te Hari, egmalig-en ka migharian din pinaahi te pegkamatareng.

4 Take_out the rust which mixed with the silver, so_that the forger will_forge vessels. 5 By means like that, if you(sg) drive_away the wicked advisor of the king, his kingdom will_be_strong through righteousness.

6 [xr]Ke eggendiye ka te Hari, kene ka sasindeg diye te tangkaan din; kene ka maa sasindeg diye te eg-ugpaan te me mabantug. 7 Meupiya pad ne egkahiyan ka, “Pamaneyik ka kayi,” du te egkamelmelehan nud iya ne egle-leihen ka diye te tangkaan te me talahuren.

6 [xr]If you(sg) (are) in front of the king, don't stand in front of him; do not also stand in the place where honored_man will_be_lived. 7 It is better if you(sg) (are) told, “Come_up here,” than for you(sg) to see your(sg) humiliation in front of the honorable.

8 Kene ka ana-ana hendiye te hukumanan tenged te nakita nu. Ke due lein ne egpakapamalehet ne naseyyup ka, egpakapeyilawan ka?

8 Don't be_in_hurry to go to the court because of what you(sg) saw. If someone else will_testify you(sg) wrong, you(sg) will_get_a_shame?

9 Emun ke nekeg-apul kew te sumbaley nu, husaya niyu seini ne sikaniyu re, wey kene niyu ipanengneng te minsan hentew, 10 su ke due egpakarineg due, egkeyilawan kew e wey egmareet e ka pegtengteng te me etew kaniyu.

9 If you(pl) argued with your(sg) neighbor, resolve it with yourselves, and don't(pl) reveal it to anyone, 10 because if someone hear it, you(pl) will_put_ to _shame and then people have bad impression on you(pl).

11 Ka lalag ne egpakasalete te eleg ne timpu,

11 The message_that_spoken at the right/coincide time,

egpekeiling te mansanas ne bulawan ne indayan-dayanan te pelata.

(is) like a golden apple that decorated with silver.

12 Ka pegsapad te matagseb ne etew diye te etew ne egpammineg kayi, egpekeiling te eritis ne bulawan wey mahal ne belieg.

12 The scolding of the wise person to the (one who) listens to it, (is) like the gold earing and expensive necklace.

13 Ka egkasalihan ne suluhuanen, egpakapahale te seeye se migsuhu kandin. Egpekeiling sikandin te maagsil ne weyig[fn] te timpu te meinit.

13 The trusted servant, can_give_happiness to the (one who) sends him. He (is) like a cold water[fn] in times of summer.

14 Ka me etew ne migsaad te minsan nekey ne kene egkatuman, egpekeiling te gapun wey kalamag ne ware egkeuyan ne uran.

14 The people who promised whatever which can't be_fulfilled, (is) like a cloud and wind without rain.

15 Ka pegpariralem wey ka me lalag ne kene ne malangit, egpakabennal te me pangulu wey te minsan hentew ne makehal se pusung.[fn]

15 The humbleness/lowering (himself) and the words that are not harsh, can please the leaders and anyone who has a hard heart.[fn]

16 Emun ke egpakakita ka te teneb, iyan nu re keena ka eleg nu re su kema ke egpekeileb kad e.

16 If you(sg) find honey, eat just enough for you(sg) because you(sg) might vomit.

17 Marelag ke re panumbaley te sumbaley nu su kema ke egkapelaan e sikandin wey egkeepes e keykew.

17 Seldom visit your(sg) neighbor because s/he might get_tired and hate you(sg).

18 Ka etew ne egpamalehet te ubat meyitenged te sumbaley rin, egpekeiling te sundang wey ke kampilan naa, wey ke tunud naa ne maliddus.

18 The person who testify lies about his neighbor, (is) like a knife of sword, or a sharp arrow.

19 Egkeyimu ne ware karuan ke egsalig ka te etew ne kene egkasalihan te timpu te keyirapan. Su egpekeiling sikandin te tigkey wey nabalingu ne paa ne ware igpakabulig.

19 It becomes useless if you(sg) trust the person who can't be_trusted in times of difficulties. Because s/he is like tooth_ache or a twisted foot that no help.

20 Emun ke eg-ulahing ka diye te etew ne miglungku egkeulat de iya iling te inluungan nu sikandin te kumbale te timpu te tingmaagsil wey ke in-itisan nu naa te suka ka pali din.

20 If you(sg) sing to the person who mourns it will_be_worsen indeed just like you(sg) took_off her/his clothes in times of a cold (day) or either you(sg) pour her/his wound with a vinegar.

21 Emun ke eggutasan ka kuntere nu, pakeena nu sikandin; ke egkammaraan sikandin, peinuma nu 22 su emun ke eggimuwen nu sika, impunggisan nu sikandin te salakey, piru egdasahan ka mule te Magbebaye ne Manama.

21 If your(sg) enemy is hungry, feed her/him; if s/he is thirsty, have her/him drink 22 because if you(sg) do that, you(sg) unrespect(LIT removed headband) him, but you(sg) (are) rewarded on_the_contrary by the Lord God.

23 Ka pegsesalupet ka egpuunan te kabelu, iling te kalamag te igkahibang ne balabahan ne eg-uyan te uran.

23 The gossip is the source of anger, like wind (from) north (LIT left side) that brings rain.

24 Meupiya pad ke diye ka eg-ugpe te pikungan te atep te baley, du te diye ka te seled ne duma nu ka asawa nu ne mabulut.

24 It is better for you(sg) to live on the corner of the roof of your(sg) house, than you(sg) (live) there inside with your(sg) quarrelsome wife.

25 Ka meupiya ne guhuren ne egpuun te mariyu ne inged, egpekeiling te maagsil ne weyig ne egpakamanekal te nammaraan.

25 The good news from a distant place, (is) like cold water that gives_strength to the thirsty (person).

26 Ka matareng ne etew ne egparuyun-duyun de te mareet ne etew, egpekeiling te basaken ne beuhan wey ke sebseb naa ne natahuan te maligsem.

26 The righteous person who (are) just go_along with the evil person, (is) like a muddy stream or a fountain (that has) dirty.

27 Kene ne meupiya ka eg-am-amana egkeen te teneb, wey kene degma ne meupiya ka layun de egpareyrey.

27 It is not good to drink too_much honey, and it is also not good to always want praise.

28 Ka etew ne kene egpakatigkel te pegkeetew rin, egpekeiling te siyudad ne nahuhus ka alad.

28 The person who can't control himself, (is) like a city that has destroyed wall.

261 Emun ke kene eggayul ne eg-uran te apiyew te timpu te gulabung

it (is) like a bird flying that will_ just _passing_by and does not come_to_rest.

271 [xr]Kene ka peggasal meyitenged te keureme

5 Ka maddeet ne etew, ware nakasabut te eleg ne peggukum,

piru ka migtuman te igkeupii te Manama, nakasabut-sabut mule kayi.

but the (one who) obey (what) God wants, understand_ it _very well.

6 Meupiya pad ka etew ne egkaayu-ayu piru egkasalihan,

6 The poor person but can_be_trusted is better,

du te etew ne meyaman piru kene egkasalihan.

than the rich but not be_trusted.

7 Ka anak ne egtuman te Balaud, matagseb naa.

7 The child who obey the Law, (is) wise.

Piru ka anak ne egduma-ruma te me lalung ne etew,

But the child who accompany with the foolish person,

egpakapeyilew te amey wey iney rin.

can_shame to his father and mother.

8 Emun ke egkaratu ka pinaahi te pegpatubu nu te seleppi nu,

8 If you(sg) become_rich by increasing_interest of your(sg) money,

egpekeendiye ka karatuan nu te me etew ne matumpis te egkengaayu-ayu.

your(sg) wealth can go to the people who (are) generous to the poor.

9 Emun ke kene ka egtuman te me balaud,

9 If you(sg) don't obey the laws,

egkeepes ka Manama minsan te me peg-ampu nu.

the Lord hates even your(sg) prayers.

10 Emun ke egginalihen nu ka matareng ne etew eyew egpakasale,

10 If you(sg) tempt the righteous person to commit_sin,

sikeykew red mismu ka egsahad te bitu ne inggimu nu.

you(sg) yourself will_be_trapped in the pit which you(sg) have made.

Piru due keupianan nu ke ware igkarew-ey keykew.

But you(sg) can_have peace/good situation if nothing can_scold you(sg) for.

11 Ka meyaman, layun egsuman-suman ne matagseb sikandin,

11 The rich, always think that he is wise,

piru ka egkaayu-ayu ne etew ne matagseb, eg-ugsi-ugsi mule ke matagseb naan iya ka meyaman.

but the poor person who is wise (on the contrary), will_find_out if the rich_person is really wise.

12 Egkahale ka langun

12 Everyone is happy

ke iyan egkeyimu ne pangulu ka me matareng ne etew,

if the righteous people will_become leaders,

piru ke iyan egkeyimu ne pangulu ka maddeet ne etew, egpangeles ka keet-etawan.

but if the wicked people become leaders, people will_hide.

13 Kene ka iya egmatubung ke egbunbunan nu ka me sale nu,

13 You(sg) will_ not _be_prosperous if you(sg) cover_up your(sg) sins,

piru ke eg-angkenen nu seini diye te Manama wey eg-engkeran nu,

but if you(sg) confess it there in God and leave_ it _behind,

egkeyimenawan keykew ka Manama.

God will_show_mercy to you(sg).

14 Due keupianan te etew ne layun egkaaldek te Magbebaye ne Manama.

14 There_is well_being/good_living of the person who always has a fear the Lord God.

Piru ka etew ne makehal se pusung, egpekeendiye iya te karereetan.

But the person who has hard heart, can indeed go to destruction.

15 Ka pangulu ne egdeeg-deeg te egkengaayu-ayu,

15 The leader who show_contempt to the poor,

egpekeiling te liyun ne egginihel

(is) like a roaring lion

wey ke usu naa ne egpamitew te egpammueren.

or a bear looking (something) to eat.

16 Ka pangulu ne kene ne matagseb,

16 The leader who is not wise,

amana ne bubuluti wey egleig-leig.

very cruel and showing_contempt.

Piru ka etew ne kene egkeupian ne egkaratu pinaahi te mareet ne himu,

But the person who does not want to get_rich by evil doing,

egpakaangken te malayat ne umul.

receives long life.

17 Ka etew ne nakapatey te etew,

17 The person who killed a person,

nekeiling de te miglulungag e sikandin te lebeng din,

(is) only like he already dig for his grave,

purisu balahara nu sikandin.

therefore leave him alone.

18 Ka etew ne eg-ugpe ne ware igkarew-ey,

18 The person who live nothing to be_scolded_for,

egkaluwas puun te karereetan,

will_be_saved from destruction,

piru ka etew ne mareet se hinimuwan, egpekeendiye iya te karereetan.

but the person who does evil, is_indeed go to destruction.

19 Ka mabasuk ne etew, egmanubla-subla se pegkeen,

19 The hard_working person, food is_plentiful,

piru egkaayu-ayu ka etew ne egdaat-daat te timpu rin te peggimu te me ware karuan.

but poor is the person who (is) wasting his time to_do (things) without value.

20 Egpanalanginan te dakel ka etew ne egkasalihan,

20 The trustworthy person is blessed,

piru ka etew ne egkaana-ana ne egkaratu, kene egpakaalihu te legpad.

but the person who want to get_rich quickly, can't escape from the punishment.

21 Kene ne meupiya ne duen de eglapihan nu.

21 It is not good for you(sg) to side with (someone).

Piru duen iya me etew ne eggimu te iling due

But indeed there are people like that

eyew egpakakeeen de minsan deisek.

just in_order to eat even small.

22 Ka etew ne leheren, egkeupian ne mahaan egkaratu,

22 The greedy person, wants to get_rich quickly,

piru ware sikandin nakanengneng ne nasi bes sikandin egkaayu-ayu.

but he does not know that he will_get_poor [surprise].

23 Meupiya pad ne egsaparan nu ka etew,

23 It is better to rebuke the person,

su egpasalamatan ke red nikandin,

because he will still thank you(sg),

du te egdeyrayen nu sikandin te ubat.

than for you(sg) to praise him falsely.

24 Ka etew ne egpanakew diye te amey wey iney rin

24 The person who steals from his father and mother

wey egsuman-suman ne kene ne sale seeye,

and think that it is not sin,

duma red sikandin te me takawen.

he is a companion to the thieves.

25 Ka leheren ne etew, iyan egpuunan te samuk,

25 The greedy person, (is) the source of trouble,

piru ka etew ne egsalig te Magbebaye, egmatubung mule.

but the person who trusts the Lord, will_prosper.

26 Ungel ka etew ne egsalig te pegkeetew rin,[fn]

26 Foolish is the person who trusts himself,[fn]

piru ka etew ne matagseb,

but the wise person,

egpakapariyu mule te karereetan.

can_escape destruction.

27 Ka etew ne matumpis te egkaayu-ayu,

27 The generous person to the poor,

kene egkaawaan te me keilangan din.

will_ not _lack of his needs.

Piru ka etew ne leheren te egkaayu-ayu,

But the person who is greedy to the poor,

egdirilusen te me etew.

will_be_cursed by the people.

28 Emun ke iyan egkeyimu ne pangulu ka maddeet ne etew, egpangeles ka keet-etawan.

28 If the wicked people will_become the leaders, people will_hide.

Piru ke egkengaawe e sikandan te pegkapangulu ran,

But if they (are) removed from their leadership,

iyan e man-e egmandu ka me matareng.

then the righteous will be the one to rule.

291 Emun ke egpaheed-geed ka ne egpakehal te ulu nu[fn] minsan kapapila kad e sapari,

291 If you(sg) keep_on harden your(sg) head[fn] even if you(sg) have been_rebuked many times,

egginguma ka timpu ne egsahap ka, wey kene kad e egpekeenew.

time will_come you(sg) will_be_destroyed, and you(sg) can't get_up.

2 Emun ke matareng ka pangulu,

2 If the leader is righteous,

egkahale ka me etew.

people will_rejoice.

Piru ke mareet ka pangulu,

But if the leader is evil,

egkengallaggew sikandan.

they will_worry.

3 Ka etew ne egkeup-upian te katagseb,

3 The person who wants wisdom,

egpakapahale te amey rin.

can please his father.

Ka etew ne iyan de himu se egduma-ruma te malitan ne egpamelegye te lawa,

The person who just associates with the prostitute/woman selling_ her _body,

egdaat-daat de te karatuan din.

only wasting his wealth.

4 Emun ke iyan egsumsumanen te Hari ka eleg ne peggukum,

4 If only the king think (about) the right judging,

egmalig-en ka nasud.

the nation will_be_strong.

Piru ke iyan din de egsumsumanen ka seleppi,

But if he only think (about) money,

egkahuhus iya ka nasud din.

his nation will_be_destroyed.

5 Ka etew ne egdeyrey te ubat te sumbaley rin,

5 The person who praise falsely to his neighbor,

iling de te in-uney rin sahiluta ka paa rin.[fn]

it's just like he trap his_own feet.[fn]

6 Ka mareet ne etew,

6 The evil person,

egkasahilut te mareet ne hinimuwan din,

will_be_trapped by his evil doings,

piru ka matareng ne etew, eg-ul-ulahing mule wey eggale-gale.

but the righteous person, (is) singing and rejoicing.

7 Ka matareng ne etew, egsuman-suman te katenged te egkaayu-ayu.

7 The righteous person, thinks about the right of the poor.

Piru kene mule egpakasuman-suman kayi ka maddeet ne etew.

But on_the_contrary the wicked people will_ not _think about it.

8 Ka me etew ne lemeten,

8 The mocker people,

iyan egpuunan ne egkasamuk ka intiru ne siyudad,

(are) the reasons of trouble in the entire city,

piru ka me matagseb, iyan egpakabewu te kabelu.

but the wise, can_cool_down the anger.

9 Emun ke egpakig-apul ka matagseb ne etew te ungel,

9 If the wise person argued with the foolish,

egngisi re ka ungel, wey egpanampele,

the foolish will_ just _laughing, and bullying,

wey kene egpeeneng-eneng.

and doesn't stop.

10 Ka etew ne ware igkarew-ey,

10 The person that nothing can_be_scolded_for,

egdumutan te me etew ne talaggimatey,

(is) hate by the murderer people,

piru egpangabangan sikandin te me etew ne matareng.

but he (is) help by the righteous people.

11 Kene egpakatigkel ka ungel te kabelu din,

11 The foolish can't control his anger,

piru ka matareng ne etew, mahaan egpakatigkel te langet din.

but the righteous person, easily control his anger.

12 Emun ke egpalintutuu te ubat ne guhuren ka pangulu,

12 If the leader believes the false message,

egkeyimu ne mareet ka langun ne upisyal rin.

all of his officials will_ also _become bad.

13 Ka egkaayu-ayu, wey ka egleig-leig,

13 The poor, and the mocker,

nekeg-iling de sikandan ne imbehayan te Magbebaye ne Manama te mata.

they (are) both given eye(s) by the Lord God.

14 Ke meupiya ka peggukum te Hari diye te egkengaayu-ayu,

14 If judgment of the king to the poor is good,

eghari sikandin te ware egtamanan.

he will_king without end.

15 Ka peglampes wey pegsapad,

15 The spanking and correcting,

egpakabehey te katagseb te bate.

can_give wisdom to the child.

Piru ke egbalaharen de sikandin,

But if you(sg) leave_ him _alone,

egpakapeyilew re sikandin te iney rin.

he can put_ his mother _to_shame.

16 Emun ke mareet ka pangulu,

16 If the leader is evil,

egmasulug degma ka me etew ne eggimu te mareet.

people who do evil will_ also _become many.

Piru egkengaddeetan sikandan wey egkakita te me matareng ka pegkareeti ran.

But they will_be_destroy and the righteous(pl) will_see their destruction.

17 Panulua nu ka anak nu taheed te bate pad sikandin,

17 Teach your(sg) child while s/he is still young,

eyew kene ka egkallagew kandin,

so_that you(sg) can't worry of him,

wey layun nu sikandin igkahale.

and you(sg) always happy with him/her.

18 Ware keupianan te nasud

18 The nation has no peace/well_being

ke ware lalag te Manama ne egpakapanulu.

if there's no word of God that able_to_teach.

Piru due keupianan te seeye se migtuman te Balaud te Manama.

But there's well_being to those who obey the Law of God.

19 Kene egkapanulu ka suluhuanen pinaahi te me lalag de,

19 The servant can't be_corrected by words only,

su minsan egpakasabut ded sikandin,

because even if s/he understands,

kene iya sikandin egpammineg.

s/he won't be_listening.

20 Duen pad egkapallateng te etew ne subla ne ungel

20 The extreme foolish has something to hope_for

du te etew ne egpanaweles de due eglalag.

than the person who talks nonsense.

21 Ke eg-upianan nu ka suluhuanen nu puun pad te pegkabate din,

21 If you(sg) treat_ your(sg) servant _kindly since s/he was young,

diye egpangkus te egkaangken din ka langun ne keykew te mewuri ne timpu.

it will_end_up that s/he will_own everything you(sg) have in the last day.

22 Ka etew ne mahaan egkabelu,

22 The person who quickly get_angry,

iyan egpuunan te samuk,

(is) the source of trouble,

wey egpekeyimu te dakel ne sale.

and able_to_commit big sin(s).

23 Egkeyilawan ka etew ne hambuhen,

23 The arrogant person will_put_to_shame,

piru egtahuren mule ka mapariralemen.

but on_the_contrary the humble will_be_honored.

24 Ka etew ne egduma-ruma te takawen,

24 The person who associates with the thief,

egdereet de te kandin mismu ne pegkeetew.

will_ only _destroy his own_self.

Egsaad sikandin ne egpamalehet,

S/he promise to testify,

piru kene sikandin egpangguhud te malehet.

but s/he can't tell the truth.

25 Emun ke egkaaldek ka te etew, nasi ka egsahap.

25 If you(sg) (are) afraid of the person, you(sg) will_be_in_danger.

Piru egkaluwas ka ke egsalig ka te Magbebaye.

But you(sg) will_be_saved if you(sg) trust in the Lord.

26 Masulug ka egkeupian ne eglapihan te pangulu,

26 Many (people) want/seek to be_sided by the leader,

piru diye de te Magbebaye egkaangken te etew ka eleg ne peggukum.

but the person can only receives the right judgment in the Lord.

27 Ka matareng ne etew, egkeepes te mareet ne etew,

27 The righteous person, hate the evil person,

wey ka mareet ne etew, egkeepes degma te matareng ne etew.

and the evil person, will_ also _hate the righteous person.

Ka me lalahen ni Agur

The words of Agur

301 Seini ka immanlalag ni Agur ne anak ni Haki ne matig-Masa. Inlalag din seini diye ki Itiil wey ki Ukal. Migkahi sikandin:

301 These (are) the sayings of Agur the child of Haki from_Masa. He said these to Itiil and Ukal. He said:

2 “Te langun ne etew, sikeddi ka subla ne ungel

2 “Of all the people, I (am) the most foolish

su ka suman-suman ku, kene ne iling te suman-suman te etew.

because my thinking, is not like the thinking of the person/human.

3 Wara ad iya migbebasbas eyew egmatagseb

3 I have never tried_to_learn to get_wisdom

wey ware degma kalintahaan[fn] ku meyitenged te Magbebaye ne Manama.

and I have also no understanding[fn] about the Lord God.

4 Angin e te Manama, hentew naa ka egpekeendiye te langit wey nakapamaneug de man-e?

4 Aside of God, who can gone_up to heaven and come_back_down again?

Duen naan e etew ne nakahen-gen te kalamag?

Has any person hold/touch the wind?

Duen naan e etew ne nakabubugsung te weyig te kumbale din?

Has any person wrap_up the water in his clothes?

Hentew naa ka migtahu te eletanan te kalibutan?

Who put the boundary of the earth?

Ke due, hentew ka ngaran din, wey ka me ngaran te me anak din?

If there is, what's his name, and the name of his children?

Kema ke nakanengneng kew iya?

You(pl) might know?

5 “Egtumanen iya te Magbebaye ka me saad din. Egpekeiling sikandin te kalasag te seeye se eg-aput kandin. 6 Kene nu timuli ka me lalag din su kema ke egsaparan ka nikandin, wey igpanengneng din ne ubaten ka.”

5 “The Lord is_indeed fulfill his promises. He is like a shield to those who seek_protection to him. 6 Do not add his words because he might rebuke you(sg), and he will_let you(sg) know that you(sg) (are) a liar.”

Ka duma pad ne me lalahen

The more sayings

7 Magbebaye, due ubag daruwa ne egbuyuen ku keykew. Ibehey nu naa ubag seini te kene e pad egpatey. 8 An-anayan, bulihi a ne kena a egpekeuubat. Igkarangeb, kena a himuwa ne meyaman wey ke egkaayu-ayu naa, alahaa nu re ka egkakeen ne keilangan ku. 9 Su emun ke meyaman a, kema ke kene kud sikeykew egkeilangana; ne emun ke egkaayu-ayu a man-e, kema ke egpakapanakew a wey egkapeyilawan ku ka matulus ne ngaran nu.

7 Lord, there are two (things) I want to ask (from) you(sg). (Please) give it to me before I die. 8 First, help me that I can't lie. Second, don't make me rich or poor, just estimate the food that_ I _need. 9 Because if I am rich, I might not need you(sg); and if am poor also, I might steal and put_ your(sg) holy name _in_shame.

10 Kene nu bayungi ka suluhuanen diye te tangkaan te ahalen din, su ke ma ke egdilusen ka nikandin wey eg-antus ka.

10 Don't accuse the servant in front of her/his master, because he might curse you(sg) and you(sg) will_suffer.

11 Due me anak ne kene egtahud te amey wey iney ran, wey egpekeyimu pad iya man-e ne egdilus kandan.

11 There (are) children that do not honor their father and mother, and they even curse them.

12 Due me etew ne migsuman-suman ne malinis sikandan, kunaleg te malindit bes ka pegkeetew ran.

12 There (are) people who think that they (clean), but [surprisingly] their own_self (are) dirty.

13 Due me etew ne subla ne me hambuhen, wey kenad sikandan egkateu ne egsil-ap te duma ran.

13 There (are) people that (are) very arrogant, and they_even don't know (how) to glance their fellow.

14 Due me etew ne subla ne egleig-leig te egkengaayu-ayu wey te ware egkeyimu iling te kampilan ne egdereet. Egkengeuyag sikandan pinaahi te sika ne hinimuwan dan.

14 There (are) people who cruely take_advantage of the poor and to the (one who) has nothing (LIT can't do anything) like sword that can_destroy. They survive by that doings of them.

15 Ka etew ne leheren, egpekeiling te limatek ne due daruwa ne anak ne layun de egkahi, “Behayi a! Behayi a!”

15 The greedy person, (is) like a leech that has two children who always say, “Give me! Give me!”

Due hep-at ne kene egkeuralan:

There are four (things) that never satisfied:

16 ka inged te me minatey,

16 the place of the dead,

ka malitan ne kene egpakaanak,

the woman that can't bear_children,

ka tane ne keilangan te weyig,

the land that needs rain,

wey ka hapuy ne kene egkataman.

and the fire that never ends.

17 Emun ke egdali-dian nu wey ke egsupaken nu ka amey wey iney nu, meupiya pad ke igpatuktuk te uwak ka mata nu, wey igpakeen te me banug ka lawa nu.

17 If you(sg) mock or disobey your(sg) father and mother, it is better for the crow to peck_ your(sg) eye(s) _out, and to_feed your(sg) body to eagles.

18 Due hep-at ne igkeinu-inu ku wey kene ku egkasabut:

18 There (are) four (things) that I am wondering and I can't understand:

19 Mania te egpakalayang ka banug diye te aw-awangan,

19 Why can_ an eagle _fly in the sky/heaven,

mania te egpakarul-ug ka uled diye te me batuwen,

why snake can crawl on rocks,

mania te eg-antew ka barku diye te dahat,

why ship float in the sea,

wey mania te egpekeg-alig ka lukes wey malitan?

and why man and woman desire_each_other?

20 Ne iling kayi ka eggimuwen te malitan ne egpalibug-libug: emun ke egkalibuhan e sikandin, egkahi e sikandin, “Ware mareet ne neyimu ku.”

20 And this is what adulterous woman (is) doing: if she commits_adultery, she says, “I did nothing wrong.”

21 Due hep-at ne kene egkarawat te me etew te kalibutan:

21 There (are) four (things) that people on earth can't accept:

22 ka uripen ne egkeyimu ne Hari,

22 the slave who become King,

ka ungel ne dakel se egkakeen,

the foolish that eat lots,

23 ka bubuluti ne malitan ne egpakaasawa red,

23 the very cruel woman that get_married,

wey ka uripen ne malitan ne egpakasubal egpakaasawa te ahalen din ne malitan.

and the slave woman who takes_ the _place of the woman who owns her.

24 Due hep-at ne klasi te dereisek ne mananap kayi te kalibutan piru amana ne matagseb:

24 There (are) four kinds of the small animals here on earth but very clever:

25 ka me iteng, minsan kene sikandan ne mannekal, piru egmanlilimud sikandan te egkakeen dan te timpu te meinit;

25 the ants, even if they (are) not strong, but they gather_up their food in summer (LIT hot) time;

26 ka me mananap ne egngaranan te kunihu, minsan kene sikandan ne mannekal, piru diye sikandan migpangugpe te batuwen;

26 the animal called kunihu, even if they (are) not strong, but they live on rocks;

27 ka me talangas, minsan ware Hari dan, piru egkasabeka iya sikandan ka egluyud;

27 the locust, even if they don't have King, but they march unitedly;

28 ka me tektek, ne egkarakep nu re te belad nu, piru egkakita nu sikandan diye te me palasyu te me Hari.

28 the lizards, that you(sg) can just hold your(sg) hand(s), but you(sg) can see them in the kings' palace.

29 Due hep-at ne meupiya ne egpitawen ke egpangipanew:

29 There (are) four (things) that (are) nice to look_at when walking:

30 ka liyun ne ware igkaaldek wey subla ne manekal te langun ne mananap;

30 the lion that nothing to be_afraid_of and very strong of all animals;

31 ka lumansad ne manuk, ka lukesan ne kambing,

31 the rooster chicken, the male goat,

wey ka Hari ne egpangulu te me sundalu rin.

and the king who lead his soldiers.

32 Emun ke egkeungel kad e ka eggelebek egpaambug wey egpamalanu te mareet, ipeeneng-eneng nud e sika! 33 Emun ke eggelebekan nu te egkulibew ka gatas, egkehal iya sika; ke egsumbahen nu ka irung te etew, egpakalangesa iya sika; ke eglelalis ka, egpakakita ka iya te samuk.

32 If you(sg) become foolish by keeping_on (talking)_arrogantly and planning evil, stop it! 33 If you(sg) keep_on stirring the milk, it becomes_hard indeed; if you(sg) punch the nose of a person, it really bleeds; if you(sg) threaten (someone), you(sg) indeed will_find trouble.

Ka me lalahen te Hari

The sayings of the king

311 Seini ka immanlalag ni Hari Limwil ne matig-Masa. Impanulu kandin seini te iney rin:

311 These (are) the sayings of King Limwil from_Masa. These were_taught to him by his mother:

2 “Sikeykew se anak ne nabaley te aanakan ku; Imbuyu ku sikeykew te Manama sikan naa ka neetew ka. 3 Kene nu da-daati ka kanekal nu diye te me malitan ne egpakarereet te me Hari. 4 Limwil, kene ne meupiya ne eg-inum te binu ka me Hari, kene ne meupiya te me pangulu ka egkeibeg-ibeg te inumen. 5 Su emun ke egkewubug e sikandan, egkalingawan dan e ka Balaud wey egdi-diekan dan e ka katenged te langun ne egkaayu-ayu. 6 Balahara nu re ne ig-inum te subla ne egpekewubug ne binu ka seeye se mahaan e egpatey wey seeye se eg-antus te subla ne masakit. 7 Peinuma nu iya sikandan eyew egkalingawan dan ka me keyirapan wey eyew kene dan e egkasuman-suman ka pegkaayu-ayu ran.”

2 “You(sg) my child that form in my womb; I ask you(sg) by God that's why you(sg) are born. 3 Don't waste your(sg) strength to the women who can_destroy the kings. 4 Limwil, it is not good for the kings to drink wine, it is not good for the leaders to crave for drink. 5 Because if they get_drunk, they forget the Law and they step_on the right of all the poor. 6 Just(sg)_let_those who (are) dying drink_wine that can (extremely)_cause drunkenness and those who (are) suffering from extreme pain. 7 Let(sg) them drink so_that they will_forget the difficulties and so_that they can't remember their poverty.”

8 “Lalag ka eyew egkapangabangan te katenged ka me etew ne kene egpakapangabang te pegkeetew ran. 9 Keilangan ne ka peggukum nu, egpekeikul te gantangan wey palabian. Lalag ka eyew te pegpangabang te katenged te egkengaayu-ayu wey te seeye se ware egkekeyimu.”

8 “Talk(sg) in_order to help the right of the people who can't help themselves. 9 It is necessary that your(sg) judging, can follow the law and justice (LIT measuring_can and stick). Talk(sg) in_order to defend the right of the poor and those who (are) needy (LIT can_do_nothing).”

Ka meupiya ne asawa ne malitan

The good spouse/wife

10 Malised ne egpamitawen ka meupiya ne asawa wey mahal pad sikandin du te mahal ne me batu.

10 It is difficult to find a good wife and she is more expensive than expensive stones.

11 Egkasalig kandin ka iglukes din, wey warad egkeilanganen pad te iglukes din diye te kandin.

11 Her husband trust her, and her husband need no more in her.

12 Kene sikandin eggimu te egpakarereet te iglukes din, su layun de ne meupiya ka eggimuwen din te intiru ne umul rin.

12 She will_ not _do (anything) to destroy her husband, because what she will_do is always good with her entire life.

13 Maali-ali sikandin ne egpangimu te me kumbale ne linu puun te bulbul te karniru.

13 She is eager to make linen clothes from the sheeps' skin.

14 Egpekeiling sikandin te barku ne egpanguyan te egkakeen puun te mariyu ne inged.

14 She is like a ship that brings food from far place(s).

15 Eggimate e sikandin te kene pad egkasi-si ka kaliwaswasan eyew eggilutu te egkakeen dan te taltalaanak, wey eyew egpanengneng te me suluhuanen dan ke nekey ka eggimuwen dan.

15 She gets_up before daylight to cook food for (her) family, and to instruct their servants what they (should) do.

16 Egpamitew sikandin te tane wey egbeliyen din seini te seleppi ne inlimud din, wey egpamulaan din te paras.

16 She looks at land and she buys it with the money she saved_up, and she plants (it) with vineyard(s).

17 Maali-ali sikandin wey manekal ne egtrabahu.

17 She (is) eager and hard working.

18 Nakanengneng sikandin ke pila ka egkaseleppi din te sika ne eggimuwen din. Sikan naa kene egkeebukan ka sulu din te marusilem.

18 She knows how much she earns of what she makes. That's why her lamp will not turning off at night.

19 Sikandin mismu ka egpangimu te hinabel eyew eggimuwen din ne kumbale.

19 She makes woven_cloth by herself for making into clothes.

20 Matumpis sikandin te egkaayu-ayu wey te me ware egkengeyimu.

20 She (is) generous to the poor and to the (ones who) can't make_a_living(pl).

21 Kene sikandin egkalaggew te timpu ne eg-uran te apiyew su duen ma makepal ne manggad[fn] para te pamilya rin.

21 She does not worry when it's time of raining of ice because there's a thick cloth[fn] for her family.

22 Egpangimu sikandin te hagpi te me hibatanan wey egsaluub sikandin te mahal ne kumbale ne malugtem se batek.

22 She makes cover for bed and she wears expensive clothes which is purple.

23 Neilaan ka iglukes din[fn] wey sabeka sikandin te me pangulu diye te lungsud dan.

23 Her husband was well_known[fn] and he (is) one of the leaders in their town.

24 Egpaneyi sikandin te me kumbale wey me sinturun eyew igpamelegye din diye te me nigusyanti.

24 She sews clothes and belts to sell to the merchants/business_people.

25 Makeseg-keseg sikandin wey egtahuren, wey kene sikandin egkaaldek ke nekey ka egginguma.

25 She (is) strong and honored, and she (is) not afraid of what is coming.

26 Matagseb sikandin ne eglalag wey meupiya ka pamaahi rin te pegpanulu.

26 She talks wisely and she has good ways of teaching.

27 Mabasuk sikandin wey amana rin eg-atimana ka pamilya rin.

27 She works_hard and she takes_good_care of her family.

28 Inggeyinawaan sikandin wey indeyrey te me anak din wey te iglukes din.

28 She (is) love and praised by her children and her husband.

29 Egkahi ka iglukes din, “Masulug ka meupiya ne asawa piru ware egpekeiling keykew.”

29 Her husband says, “Many good wives but no one can compare with you(sg).”

30 Ka kateles te malitan, egpakalimbung iya wey duen de katamanan. Piru ka malitan ne pegkaaldek te Magbebaye ne Manama, eleg ne egdayanen.

30 The beauty of the woman, indeed can_deceive and has ending. But the woman who has a fear of the Lord God, worthy to be_praised.

31 Deyraya nu sikandin te langun ne neyimu rin. Ne tenged te meupiya ne neyimu rin egtahuren sikandin te me etew.

31 Praise her with everything she was done. And because of the good (things) she did people will_respect her.
